name: ApplyAdamWV2
reference:
import torch
import math

def run(param, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, max_exp_avg_sq, grad, step, lr, beta1, beta2, weight_decay, eps, amsgrad, maximize):
    dtype = param.dtype
    if grad.dtype != dtype:
        grad = grad.to(dtype)
        max_exp_avg_sq = max_exp_avg_sq.to(dtype)
    if maximize:
        grad = -grad
    step_val = int(step.item()) + 1
    param = param * (1 - lr * weight_decay)
    exp_avg.lerp_(grad, 1 - beta1)
    exp_avg_sq.mul_(beta2).addcmul_(grad, grad, value=1 - beta2)
    bias_correction1 = 1 - beta1 ** step_val
    bias_correction2 = 1 - beta2 ** step_val
    step_size = lr / bias_correction1
    bias_correction2_sqrt = math.sqrt(bias_correction2)
    if amsgrad:
        torch.maximum(max_exp_avg_sq, exp_avg_sq, out=max_exp_avg_sq)
        denom = (max_exp_avg_sq.sqrt() / bias_correction2_sqrt) + eps
    else:
        denom = (exp_avg_sq.sqrt() / bias_correction2_sqrt) + eps
    param.addcdiv_(exp_avg, denom, value=-step_size)
    return param, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, max_exp_avg_sq
description: Fused AdamW optimizer step. Updates param, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, and optionally max_exp_avg_sq using gradient descent with AdamW algorithm. Supports amsgrad variant and maximize mode. Returns (param, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, max_exp_avg_sq) tuple. In-place updates on exp_avg and exp_avg_sq.
